# SandBase

> AI agent infrastructure platform for enabled language, image, video, audio, search, and data capabilities, plus Agent workflows. Use live discovery instead of a fixed catalog count.

## API Base URL

https://api.sandbase.ai/v1

## Authentication

Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY`

## Connect AI Tools

Guided Setup: https://www.sandbase.ai/console/setup

Choose a client in Setup and follow the exact guidance shown there. For a CLI-supported client such as Codex:

`curl -fsSL https://sandbase.ai/install.sh | sh -s -- --client codex`

Read-only installer client catalog:

`curl -fsSL https://sandbase.ai/install.sh | sh -s -- --list-agents`

Diagnose a CLI-managed client:

`npx -y @sandbaseai/cli doctor --client codex`

Installation and authorization are not proof of connectivity. Verify the SandBase entry and tools in the target client, then complete one safe tool request.

Open-source CLI: https://github.com/sandbaseai/cli

## Core APIs

- POST /v1/chat/completions - OpenAI-compatible chat; optional capabilities depend on the selected model
- POST /v1/messages - Anthropic-compatible messages API
- POST /v1/run - Submit a model generation using its model-specific schema
- GET /v1/run/{id} - Poll async generation status
- GET /v1/models - List enabled logical models (OpenAI-compatible; defaults to type=llm)
- GET /v1/models/{id_or_name} - Get model details, schema, capabilities, and pricing
- GET /v1/tasks/{id}/cost - Get task cost and usage

## Agent Lifecycle
Agents platform resources accept `Authorization: Bearer` or `X-API-Key` and return {"error":{"type","code","param","message"}}.
- POST /v1/agents - Create a saved, versioned Agent (agt_)
- POST /v1/agents/{agent_id} - Update an Agent (SDK style); PATCH /v1/agents/{agent_id} updates with row_version
- POST /v1/agents/{agent_id}/archive - Archive an Agent; DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id} also archives
- POST /v1/agents/sessions - Create a Session (ses_) for a saved Agent
- GET /v1/agents/sessions/{session_id}/events - Live-only event stream (SSE); open it before sending input
- POST /v1/agents/sessions/{session_id}/events - Send one agent.session.input.message or agent.session.input.cancel event (202)
- GET /v1/agents/sessions/{session_id}/items - Read Session history
- POST /v1/services - Create a Service (svc_) pinned to an Agent version; Idempotency-Key required
- POST /v1/services/{service_id}/invoke - Start a Run (run_); returns 202 with status pending
- POST /v1/schedules - Create a cron Schedule (sch_); Idempotency-Key required
- POST /v1/schedules/{schedule_id}/runs - Trigger a manual Schedule Run
- POST /v1/skills - Upload a Skill ZIP (skl_)
- POST /v1/mcp-connections - Register a remote HTTPS MCP server (mcp_)
- POST /v1/secrets - Store a write-only MCP Bearer token (sec_)
## Session and Run Contract
- A Session runs one saved Agent version and freezes its Skills and MCP connections when it starts.
- Each Service invocation and each Schedule firing or manual trigger creates one Run, and each Run creates its own Session reported in session_id.
- Run status is pending, succeeded, failed, cancelled, or (Schedules only) skipped. Failed and skipped Runs carry error_code.
- Only one Run per Service or Schedule can be pending; another invocation returns 429 concurrency_limit.
- Internal Runtime Session identities are never exposed.
## Pricing

Pricing formulas and billing units differ by model. Use GET /v1/models for discovery and GET /v1/models/{id_or_name} for the current
model card, capabilities, input schema, and detailed pricing. Use GET /v1/tasks/{id}/cost for recorded task cost.
